diagnosis: Customer's region ap-south is not supported for private networking; KB-0008 confirms it is not yet available there. The account plan is business tier, which may also lack the premium entitlement for this feature per KB-0010.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. Private networking is currently available only in us-east, us-west, and eu-west regions. It is not yet available in ap-south. Requests made from unsupported regions are queued rather than failing, so no action is needed on your end. We do not have a timeline for when support may be added to ap-south, but you can keep an eye on our documentation for future updates. If you have any other questions, please let us know.
